Zhu et al. synthesized nominal FA50 from two runs whose recovered compositions were (Mg0.50Fe0.52)(Al0.47Si0.51)O3 and (Mg0.47Fe0.52)(Al0.46Si0.55)O3. The source does not map those two analyses to the individual XRD grains, so no grain-specific exact formula is inferred. Recovered material is LiNbO3-type at ambient conditions and converts to Pbnm bridgmanite above 18.8 GPa; consequently no ambient bridgmanite lattice or atom coordinates are fabricated here, and every V0 is a high-pressure-branch extrapolation. Sample 1 was stepwise laser annealed and develops a gradual mixed population of A-site high-spin and B-site low-spin Fe3+ through pressure-driven Fe-Al exchange. Sample 2 was cold compressed after its initial synthesis/anneal treatment and is the authors' reference for the original high-spin A-site ordering. The source supports no independently fitted, fully low-spin EOS branch.
